# crewmate

> crewmate is a CLI that watches GitHub PR comments (review and conversation) and issues for `@crewmate` mentions and replies with an explanation or a generated fix.

Important notes:

- End users install the published package with `npm install -g crewmate`; development of this repository requires [Nub](https://nubjs.com).
- `crewmate` shells out to the GitHub CLI (`gh`) and to a `claude`-shaped LLM provider CLI, so both must be installed and authenticated.
- `crewmate watch` replies on GitHub, `crewmate stream` emits mentions as NDJSON, and `crewmate init` writes the global config.

## User docs

- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YogliB/crewmate/main/README.md): Overview, usage, flags, and configuration.
- [assets/help.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YogliB/crewmate/main/assets/help.md): Help text shown by `crewmate --help`.
- [docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YogliB/crewmate/main/docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md): Common runtime problems.
- [docs/CHANGELOG.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YogliB/crewmate/main/docs/CHANGELOG.md): Version history and release notes.

## Contributor docs

- [docs/CONTRIBUTING.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YogliB/crewmate/main/docs/CONTRIBUTING.md): Bug reports, enhancement suggestions, style guides, and commit conventions.
- [docs/SECURITY.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YogliB/crewmate/main/docs/SECURITY.md): Supported versions and how to report vulnerabilities privately.
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YogliB/crewmate/main/AGENTS.md): Entry point for coding agents; summarizes setup, scripts, and key files.

## Implementation

- [src/bin.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YogliB/crewmate/main/src/bin.ts): CLI entry point.
- [src/index.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YogliB/crewmate/main/src/index.ts): Command dispatch, poll loop, `watch`, and `stream`.
- [src/fix.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YogliB/crewmate/main/src/fix.ts): Reply generation and fix application.
- [src/config.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YogliB/crewmate/main/src/config.ts): Global and per-repo configuration resolution.

## Optional
